patch_description: Replace independent per-destination shortest paths with a Steiner-tree-like shared backbone. We iteratively grow a shared directed tree from src using Dijkstra on the sanitized graph h, merging each destination's shortest path into the tree only once (edges already in the tree are reused for free). Then each destination's path is read from the tree. This shares edges across destinations, reducing total transfer cost while keeping the exact same output contract (per-dst, per-partition edge appends with [s, t, G[s][t]]). All edge data is read from G only for the final append, pathfinding on h only, matching the validated Gen 0 behavior.
